headline: Three Waste Squares Reclaimed; Nevish Line Yields a Post
war_summary: Three of the five waste squares noted in the morning edition have been reclaimed and re-garrisoned, leaving two, both in Fisherman's Row, which stands seven Colonial to two waste after ten events of late and fifty-eight across the day. Nevish Line has yielded ground: Colonials now hold two squares against six Warden, with nine events in the past two hours, the freshest work on any front. Stlican Shelf shifted the other way, the Wardens recovering a third square against six Colonial along a line that has seen sixty events in a day, chiefly at Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost. The Weathered Expanse is likewise whole again, eight Colonial to one Warden, after twenty-seven events. Callahan's Passage remains wholly Warden with sixty-eight events, The Latch alone accounting for thirty-eight. Mooring County, eleven Warden to one Colonial, reports twelve events. Viper Pit, seven of eight squares Warden, logged the heaviest exchange of the hour — some 443 Colonial and 185 Warden casualties — without a change of colors. Across 436 strongpoints the Colonial banner flies over 311, the Warden over 123, and two lie waste.
